title: Laptop Pro Warranty & Specifications
text: Laptop Pro comes with a 2-year manufacturer warranty plus 1 year of accidental damage protection. It features a 15.6-inch 4K OLED display, 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe SSD, and Intel Core i7 processor. Technical support is available 24/7.

title: Galaxy S21 Warranty & Specifications
text: The Samsung Galaxy S21 comes with a 1-year standard manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and hardware. Warranty does not cover accidental water damage or cracked screens without Samsung Care+.

title: Fjallraven Backpack Specifications
text: The Fjallraven Backpack is crafted from durable Vinylon F fabric that resists water and dirt. It features a spacious main compartment, zippered front pocket, and two open side pockets. Capacity is 16 liters. Standard 2-year limited warranty against material and craftsmanship defects.
